## Guidewire Software Drops Over 21% After Tempering FY27 Revenue and ARR Guidance

A 21%-plus guidance-driven decline at GWRE directly challenges the vertical-AI-adoption thesis — if a well-positioned insurance-tech SaaS cannot convert AI narrative into accelerating ARR, it raises re-rating risk across enterprise AI software broadly. The key diagnostic is whether the shortfall is GWRE-specific execution or a signal of end-market (insurance carrier IT spend) softness.

- GWRE shares fell 21.1% following its earnings event.
- The sell-off is explicitly tied to tempered FY27 revenue and ARR guidance — both metrics named in the headline.
- Specific guidance figures are not disclosed in the single-outlet headline (simplywall.st).
- The 'what's changed' framing implies a thesis-shift concern beyond a routine guidance adjustment.
